subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - MNL / 116 CTN 853 KGS
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Our buyer in Riyadh, SA is importing some textile samples from us in Germany, and I’m arranging the flight for their import. Could you quote the fastest option to RUH, please?

The 2 pieces are 239 kg gross and 1.10 cbm in total. They’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29 at our site in 44616 (Dortmund), Germany. Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include it in the all-in price in EUR?

It would be great if you could also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer for this import shipment. Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-06
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - MNL / 116 CTN 853 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to MNL:
116 CTN / 853 KGS / 4.1 CBM, furniture samples
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in quote for a different shipment from Germany to Riyadh, including pickup and the fastest arrival option.
